The essence of integrating combat experience is specified as a purposeful pedagogical activity aimed at the systematic inclusion of real or simulated service and combat situations into the content, forms, and methods of instruction. The empirical basis of the study consists of the results of a survey of 48 instructors from the Kyiv Institute of the National Guard of Ukraine. The socio-professional characteristics of the respondents are analyzed, and the main difficulties of their professional activity, as well as their needs for psychological, pedagogical, and methodological support, are identified. It is found that one of the key challenges is the instructors’ ability to work effectively with adult learners who have diverse professional and life experiences. The results reveal a contradictory nature of instructors’ andragogical readiness: despite their awareness of the specifics of adult learning, the practical application of andragogical approaches remains insufficiently systematic.
